title: Comparing XAI explanations and synthetic data augmentation strategies in neuroimaging AI
core_idea: Investigate how different data augmentation strategies (baseline, augmentation with real OASIS-3 MRI scans, and synthetic data from a diffusion model) affect predictive performance and explanation stability of CNNs for brain age prediction, evaluating performance with mean absolute error and interpretability with XAI methods (DeepSHAP, Grad-CAM, occlusion) to address data imbalance and model interpretability challenges.
tldr: Compare baseline, real-data, and diffusion-model synthetic-data augmentation to assess their impact on CNN brain-age prediction accuracy and XAI explanation stability using MAE and multiple explanation methods.
